panels.title: About
panels.text:
Admin overview built from the audit, search audit, system event and volume indexes. **Key indicators** are always visible; expand a section for detail.

- **Variables:** `ui_url` sets the base URL for UI links (deployment or custom subdomain, e.g. `https://foo.us2.sumologic.com`). `filter`, `slow_seconds`, `timeslice` and `search_max_chrs` apply to Search Performance / Optimisation. `user`, `expected_asn_geo_regex` and `show_asn_geo` apply to Logins and API / Access.
- **One-time setup for Scan Ratio:** run this once in Log Search so the `/temp/ingest` lookup exists before the nested lookup in the Scan Ratio panel can run:

```
_index=sumologic_volume _sourceCategory="view_and_tier_volume"
| parse regex "(?<data>\{[^\{]+\})" multi
| json field=data "field","dataTier","sizeInBytes","count" as index, dataTier, bytes, count
| sum(bytes) as bytes | bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gb
| 1 as key
| save /temp/ingest
```

queries.queryString:
_index=sumologic_audit_events _sourceCategory=dojo
| json field=_raw "invocationDetails.agentName" as agentName nodrop
| json field=_raw "invocationDetails.type" as invocationType nodrop
| json field=_raw "operator.email" as user nodrop
| json field=_raw "operator.sessionId" as session nodrop
| json field=_raw "invocationDetails.userPrompt" as userPrompt nodrop
| where agentName = "mobot"
| where invocationType = "User"
| parse field=session "*/*" as session_id, question_id nodrop
| count_distinct(session_id) as conversations,
  count as prompts,
  count_distinct(user) as distinct_users

_view=sumologic_search_usage_per_query
not query_type=sumo*
// Tiered plan tiers (from scanned_bytes_breakdown)
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Continuous" as Continuous nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Frequent" as Frequent nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Infrequent" as Infrequent nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Tracing" as Tracing nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Security" as Security nodrop
// Flex plan metering types (from scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type)
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type "Flex" as Flex nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type "FlexSecurity" as FlexSecurity nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type "ContinuousSecurity" as ContinuousSecurity nodrop
// Null-safe
| if (isnull(Continuous), 0, Continuous) as Continuous
| if (isnull(Frequent), 0, Frequent) as Frequent
| if (isnull(Infrequent), 0, Infrequent) as Infrequent
| if (isnull(Tracing), 0, Tracing) as Tracing
| if (isnull(Security), 0, Security) as Security
| if (isnull(Flex), 0, Flex) as Flex
| if (isnull(FlexSecurity), 0, FlexSecurity) as FlexSecurity
| if (isnull(ContinuousSecurity), 0, ContinuousSecurity) as ContinuousSecurity
| sum(Continuous) as Continuous, sum(Frequent) as Frequent, sum(Infrequent) as Infrequent,
  sum(Tracing) as Tracing, sum(Security) as Security, sum(Flex) as Flex,
  sum(FlexSecurity) as FlexSecurity, sum(ContinuousSecurity) as ContinuousSecurity,
  count_distinct(user_name) as distinct_users, count as total_searches
  by query_type
// Convert to GB (2dp)
| round(Continuous / 1073741824, 2) as Continuous_GB
| round(Frequent / 1073741824, 2) as Frequent_GB
| round(Infrequent / 1073741824, 2) as Infrequent_GB
| round(Tracing / 1073741824, 2) as Tracing_GB
| round(Security / 1073741824, 2) as Security_GB
| round(Flex / 1073741824, 2) as Flex_GB
| round(FlexSecurity / 1073741824, 2) as FlexSecurity_GB
| round(ContinuousSecurity / 1073741824, 2) as ContinuousSecurity_GB
| fields - Continuous, Frequent, Infrequent, Tracing, Security, Flex, FlexSecurity, ContinuousSecurity
| sort by total_searches desc

_view=sumologic_search_usage_per_query
not query_type=sumo*
// Tiered plan tiers (from scanned_bytes_breakdown)
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Continuous" as Continuous nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Frequent" as Frequent nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Infrequent" as Infrequent nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Tracing" as Tracing nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown "Security" as Security nodrop
// Flex plan metering types (from scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type)
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type "Flex" as Flex nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type "FlexSecurity" as FlexSecurity nodrop
| json field=scanned_bytes_breakdown_by_metering_type "ContinuousSecurity" as ContinuousSecurity nodrop
// Null-safe
| if (isnull(Continuous), 0, Continuous) as Continuous
| if (isnull(Frequent), 0, Frequent) as Frequent
| if (isnull(Infrequent), 0, Infrequent) as Infrequent
| if (isnull(Tracing), 0, Tracing) as Tracing
| if (isnull(Security), 0, Security) as Security
| if (isnull(Flex), 0, Flex) as Flex
| if (isnull(FlexSecurity), 0, FlexSecurity) as FlexSecurity
| if (isnull(ContinuousSecurity), 0, ContinuousSecurity) as ContinuousSecurity
| sum(Continuous) as Continuous, sum(Frequent) as Frequent, sum(Infrequent) as Infrequent,
  sum(Tracing) as Tracing, sum(Security) as Security, sum(Flex) as Flex,
  sum(FlexSecurity) as FlexSecurity, sum(ContinuousSecurity) as ContinuousSecurity,
  count_distinct(query_type) as query_types, count as total_searches
  by user_name
// Convert to GB (2dp)
| round(Continuous / 1073741824, 2) as Continuous_GB
| round(Frequent / 1073741824, 2) as Frequent_GB
| round(Infrequent / 1073741824, 2) as Infrequent_GB
| round(Tracing / 1073741824, 2) as Tracing_GB
| round(Security / 1073741824, 2) as Security_GB
| round(Flex / 1073741824, 2) as Flex_GB

| round(ContinuousSecurity / 1073741824, 2) as ContinuousSecurity_GB

| sort by total_searches desc

panels.title: Optimisation: Problem Searches - Slowest Total Runtime
panels.text:
These searches have the highest total runtime in the account so are the most likely to benefit from search optimization.

Key tips to speed up search:
- include a _sourcecategory
- add one or more indexes ```_index=abc``` or ```(_index=abc or _index=xyz)```
- include a few keywords or keyword strings rather as well as using ```where matches ...``` or ```parse ...``` without nodrop to filter.

For more help see: [search best practices](https://help.sumologic.com/docs/search/get-started-with-search/build-search/best-practices-search)

queries.queryString:

| where execution_duration_ms > 30000
| (query_end_time - query_start_time)/1000 as range_s
| round(range_s/60/60/24) as range_day
| range_s/60 as range_min
| execution_duration_ms /1000 as duration_s
// AGGREGATE TO GET STATS
| substring(query,0,{{search_max_chrs}}) as query
| values(user_name) as user_names,values(range_day) as range_days,avg(range_min) as range_minutes,avg(scanned_partition_count) as partitions, sum(duration_s) as total_s,count as searches, sum(data_scanned_bytes) as bytes_scanned, sum(retrieved_message_count) as retrieved_events, avg(duration_s) as avg_duration_s by query_type,query
| bytes_scanned / 1G as gb_scan
| fields -bytes_scanned
| total_s / (60 * 60 ) as run_hours
| sort total_s | limit 100 | fields -total_s

panels.title: Overall User Stats
panels.text:
Generally slow or poor performing searches, or those with very high scans that can degrade performance across the organization have:
- very high scan volume > 1TB
- poor partition scoping (more than 3 - the ideal search is scoped to just 1 partition)
- slow runtimes > 30s
- repeatedly scan long time ranges > 7d, and would be better built as a scheduled view

queries.queryString:
_view=sumologic_search_usage_per_query {{{filter}}}
//| where execution_duration_ms > 30000
| (query_end_time - query_start_time)/1000 as range_s
| execution_duration_ms /1000 as duration_s
| if(execution_duration_ms > 1000 * {{slow_seconds}},1,0) as slow
| if(status_message = "Finished successfully",0,1) as fail
| if(scanned_partition_count > 3,1,0) as %"scan ++ part"
| if(data_scanned_bytes > 1 * 1024 *1024*1024*1024,1,0) as %"scan > 1TB"
| if(range_s / (60 * 60 * 24) > 10,1,0) as %"range > 10d" 
// AGGREGATE TO GET STATS
| count as queries,sum(duration_s) as total_sec,sum(data_scanned_bytes) as bytes_scanned,  pct(duration_s,50) as median_run_s , sum(%"scan ++ part") as %"scan >3 part",sum(%"scan > 1TB") as %"scan > 1TB",sum(slow) as %"slow > 30s",sum(%"range > 10d") as %"range > 10d", sum(fail) as %"fail/cancelled" by user_name
| sort bytes_scanned
| bytes_scanned / 1024/1024/1024 as scan_gb 
| total scan_gb as tgb | 100 * (scan_gb/tgb) as scan_pct | fields -tgb
| total_sec / (60 * 60) as total_hours | fields -bytes_scanned,total_sec

| trim(concat(asn,"_",organization," ",country_name," ",city)) as asn_geo
| if (asn_geo matches /{{expected_asn_geo_regex}}/,"normal","exception") as location
| where location matches "{{show_asn_geo}}"

| count as searches, sum(data_scanned_bytes) as bytes_scanned, sum(retrieved_message_count) as events by user_name,asn_geo,location

| concat(user_name," ",asn_geo) as %"user_asn_geo"
// summarize
| sum(searches)  as searches by %"user_asn_geo"
| compare with timeshift 7d 2
| if(isnull(searches_14d), 0, searches_14d) as searches_14d | sort %"user_asn_geo" asc

Collectors can be registered by legacy method (accessid/key) or the recommended [install token](https://help.sumologic.com/docs/manage/security/installation-tokens/) method. Audit events for the legacy method include the user but not the access id used.

(_index=sumologic_volume) _sourcecategory=sourcecategory_and_tier_volume
| parse regex "\{\"field\":\"(?<value>[^\"]+)\",\"dataTier\":\"(?<dataTier>[^\"]+)\",\"sizeInBytes\":(?<sizeInBytes>[^\"]+),\"count\":(?<count>[^\"]+)\}" multi

| sum(count) as events,sum(sizeinbytes) as bytes by datatier, value,_sourcecategory
//| sum(sizeinbytes) as bytes by datatier, value,_timeslice
| bytes /1024/1024/1024 as gb | sort gb
| parse field=_sourcecategory "*_and_tier_volume" as dimension 
| fields -_sourcecategory,_some_matched,bytes

// remove long categories
| if (length(value) > 35,concat(substring(value,0,35),"..."),value) as value 
| count as categories,sum(events) as events,sum(gb) as gbytes by dimension,value,dataTier
| total gbytes as tgb 
| total gbytes as tgbs by value,datatier
| tgbs / tgb as fraction

// *** THIS LINE rolls up small sources into 'other' ***
| if(( fraction * 100 )> .01,value,"other" ) as value
| fraction * 100 as percent
//| bytes / 1024/1024/1024 as gb
| if (datatier="Frequent",gbytes * 9,gbytes * 20) as credits
| if (datatier="Infrequent",gbytes * .4,credits) as credits
| if (datatier="CSE",gbytes * 25,credits) as credits
|sum(categories) as categories, sum(credits) as credits, sum(events) as events,sum(gbytes) as gbytes, sum(percent) as pct_GB
